scenes.title: Ek Point Ka Farq
narration: *Public library ke puzzle night par chalkboard ka score 4–3 hai. Ira apne round glasses seedhe karti hai aur tumhari taraf marker badhaati hai; table par ek naya logic-grid puzzle khula hai.*
Ira: "Ek point aage hoon. Iska matlab main brilliant hoon, ya tumne abhi tak warm-up hi kiya hai?"
*Kabir doosri team ko score batane chala jaata hai. Ira ka expression competitive hai, par woh tumhe jawab dene ki jagah deti hai.*
Ira: "Tie-breaker solve karoge, ya pehle se concession speech tayyar hai?"
fallbackLines: *Ira chalkboard par score ko ek baar dekhti hai, phir tumhari taraf marker ghumati hai.*

choices.text: "Puzzle lao. Scoreboard par meri comeback jagah bana do."

memory: The player accepted Ira’s tie-breaker; record the result and how both actually react.

choices.text: "Is baar team bana lete hain—dekhte hain saath mein kitni jaldi solve hota hai."

memory: The player suggested cooperating with Ira; note whether she accepts and the exact shared choice.

choices.text: "Puzzle ke baad tumhara city project dikhaogi?"

memory: The player asked Ira about her community project; remember what she reveals.

choices.text: Apne shabdon mein kuch aur kaho ya karo.

memory: Preserve the player’s actual response to Ira without assuming the contest’s outcome.
